syntax.evidence: Script ran to completion on Python 3.14.5, all 8 steps completed without errors.

input_contract.evidence: Reads male_cleaned.csv with utf-8-sig; renames columns by position index (robust to encoding); dropna on required columns; patient as str. 1082 rows, 267 patients.

method_alignment.evidence: M1 implements approved pipeline: (1) refit Q1 GAMM for continuous prediction, (2) per-patient empirical threshold time extraction, (3) robust regression T*(BMI) with Huber M-estimator, (4) BIC-optimal segmented grouping over candidate breakpoints with min-width/min-count constraints, (5) decisional risk function R(t,BMI) = 0.4*sigmoid_delay + 0.6*normal_cdf_inaccuracy with bounded optimization. M2 implements clinical reference grouping baseline. Error sensitivity covers threshold shift (0-2%) and noise inflation (1x-3x).

reproducibility.evidence: SEED=42 globally. scipy.optimize.minimize_scalar with bounded method is deterministic. BIC grid search over candidate breakpoints is exhaustive and reproducible. Environment recorded.

output_contract.evidence: run_summary.json contains: question, round, decision_id, methods with key_results (groups/breakpoints), risk_function, error_sensitivity, seed, environment, inputs, outputs, degeneracy_check, fallback_trigger, warnings, errors. 5 figures, 3 tables, 1 metrics JSON saved.

issues.description: Column renaming uses positional index (cols[1], cols[9], etc.) rather than Chinese column names. Works but fragile if column order changes. Q1/Q3 use explicit Chinese names which is more robust.

Risk function weights (w_delay=0.4, w_inaccuracy=0.6) are hardcoded. Sensitivity to these weights is not explicitly tested, though the error sensitivity section partially covers this via noise inflation.
